name: com.game.addressables
description: Professional Addressable Asset Management System with tiered API (Simple/Standard/Advanced), complete thread-safety, intelligent tiered caching, hybrid scopes, advanced pooling, automatic memory management, explicit error handling, runtime validation, automatic monitoring, comprehensive Editor tools, rule-based automation system with 8 filter types and extensible providers, Layout Rule Editor, Layout Viewer with conflict detection, CLI tools for CI/CD, auto-apply on import, semantic versioning, composite rule merging, batch operations, custom inspectors, and real-time dashboard.

samples.description: The canonical boot sequence for a game that ships content from a CDN: initialise, check for a catalog update, apply it. One branch per boot outcome, each commented with what a real game should do there.
Six runnable examples showing the Simple, Standard and Advanced tiers side by side: simple load, session management, progress tracking, object pooling, scene scope and hierarchy scope.
A working set of layout rule, filter and provider assets wired to each other, so the automation system can be explored from something that runs rather than from empty scriptable objects.
